objective: Test inexpensive blind error detection over pre-existing hybrid analyses; not full annotation or automatic correction.

measurements.note: Quality is not inferred from response validity. Charges are pilot deltas; public-rate calculation assumes Standard Luna pricing.

accounting.note: Gateway model and account deltas agree; public token-rate calculation differs by less than one millionth of a dollar per request. Existing unresolved request was not retried.

limitations: One run per effort on the same 50 frozen cases. Known structural detection counts a case if at least one pre-recorded defect is found, not every defect within it.
The frozen reference was produced by direct model review, not independent human gold. It is imperfect and was not silently revised after API feedback.
Both efforts additionally flagged demonstrative that, interrogative Where and the topic attachment of information on. These do not inflate recall against the original ten known cases.
Some supported detections include unnecessary or incomplete proposed edits. No suggestion was applied.
Clear does not mean semantically approved. No full-corpus semantic accuracy or precision estimate is claimed.
Costs cover API review only. Extrapolation assumes the same text lengths, output volume and tariffs; it excludes rework, repeated reviews and independent adjudication.
Only Luna was run in this pilot. Other models have public unit-price comparisons, not matched task-cost or quality measurements. Claude tariff was not verified.
Prompt compacted slots to token indexes and omitted descriptors. Future pilot should explain AUX slots, EX/expl nominal slots and candidate-construction policy explicitly, then use fresh cases.
recommendation: Use medium as a candidate-error detector with contextual verification; do not use low or medium as an automatic publication gate.
